question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Mammals, Zebra, Animals
solution:
The Venn diagrams best represent the relationship between - Mammals, Zebra, Animals figures are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9b1a2a7f1c66ccaceb01485e2b27c5b41ac07727e3765d19846063a7bae588.png] 

Mammals mean an animal of the type that gives birth to live babies, not eggs and feeds its young on milk from its own body.

So, all Zebras are mammals animals.

Hence, ‘option 1’ is the correct answer.
